summary: This directory manages stream data transformations specifically focused on text encoding and decoding. It provides utilities to convert between character-based streams and binary data formats to ensure compatibility across different data processing pipelines.
responsibilities: Transforming binary data streams into character-based text streams
Converting text-based strings into binary data buffers for streaming output
Applying specified text encodings to stream data
relationships: The encoding utility functions transform stream data formats to bridge the gap between binary buffers and readable text.
Stream transformation logic depends on encoding definitions to ensure that data chunks are correctly processed during stream flow.
designDecisions: Functional approach to stream transformation using composable encoder and decoder functions
Abstracting buffer management to provide a consistent stream interface
